p.i: & successoribus e- ius in perpetuum, sicut à prædecesso- ribus nostris vsque nunc in vestra po- testate & ditione tenuistis,& dispo- suistis, Romanam ciuitatem cum du- catu suo & subur- banis,atque villi- culis omnibus, & territoriis eius mo- tanis,& maritimis litoribus,& portu- bus,ceu cunctisci- uitatibus,Castellis oppidis,ac villisin Tofcaniæ partibus.

page.notes: Right column is set in italic; the paragraph "Item quādo" opens with an indent. The left column ends with the hyphenated "In-" and the right column with "aut"; both run over to the next page. Doubtful readings: "Callių" (the final letter has an uncertain diacritic, marked [?]). Abbreviation strokes such as the macron over "quādo" and "coneniedi" are copied as they appear. No printing errors were corrected.
